<b>Sula</b> is an [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPC]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, exclusively in [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]]. A vassal of the [[Steel Society]], they are part of the <i>[[A Vassal Lost]]</i> [[wish]].

== Background ==
Sula is [[Steel Seer Zi]]'s vassal, with whom they share Masters.<ref>Steel Seer Zi: <i>"...Creature, higher... Its meeting. Zi's awakening... It is not chance... It has been sent to Zi, yes? By Masters served?... To retrieve her vassal lost?"</i></ref> Tired of watching the lands die and the bugs suffer while they serve their Masters, Sula decided to run away and call upon the [[Void]] to summon [[Summoned Saviour|a champion]] to protect themself from the Masters' wrath.<ref>Sula: <i>"But the seer knows nothing! Nothing of the pain. All small Sula's to bear... To watch, watch these lands dying, slow, the bugs suffering, falling, while our shell sustains..."</i></ref><ref>Sula: <i>"No. No. No... My champion slain! Why do you do this, cruel slasher? Why must I stay, and serve, so long, long, long?"</i></ref>

== In-game Events ==
Sula and their location only appear after accepting the <i>A Vassal Lost</i> wish and finding all three locations to advance to the final step. After slaying Sula's champion, Hornet decides not to take them back to Steel Seer Zi, and Sula promptly flees into the ground.

== Location ==
Sula can be found behind a passage in [[Bonegrave]], to the west of Chapel of the Wanderer. They only appear after finding the marked locations from the <i>A Vassal Lost</i> wish.
